title: Graduate civil engineer or civil draftsperson - expression of interest (Melbourne)
content_text: Careers page: There are currently no new vacancies. Feel free to submit an EOI. Graduate Work Experience path invited. Contact page Recruitment: Connect with our Recruitment Team today. If your passion and values resonate with ours, we will be in touch. recruitment@reedsconsulting.com.au. Civil engineering page: Get in touch with our Engineering Department via engineering@reedsconsulting.com.au. Leadership includes Haydon Day Director Engineering and Frank Mendolia Director Infrastructure and Design.
apply_instructions: Email CV and cover letter to recruitment@reedsconsulting.com.au (Contact page Recruitment section). Careers page also has an EOI form for Graduate Work Experience.
